notes.title: 1.1.0 Major Update
notes.content:
Alongside this update, Vint will be on sale through May 11th.

In this update: 
[list]
[*] Scrubbing performance improved. 

[*] Config changes apply instantly. Occasional file opening crash fixed. 

[*] Default video player app setting improved. Launch page directs user to set as default.

[*] Various UI improvements, notifications, and advanced settings menu. Transcode file names work.

[*] Nvidia RTX Video Super Resolution toggle added.

[*] CRT Emulation allows user configurable integer multiples.

[*] Updated dependencies: Nvidia TensorRT, MPV, vsmlrt, AMD MIGX, yt-dlp,
[/list]

Also, check out this related article on Blur Busters: https://blurbusters.com/flicker-vs-framegen/
